name: single_broll
description: Single-cam monologue talking-head short WITH optional b-roll cutaways. Identical to 'single' plus a 'broll' stage between grade and captions, so captions burn LAST over the b-roll (CLIP_CUTTING_PLAYBOOK b-roll rules). With no stages.broll.items configured the broll stage is a passthrough.

notes.reframe.preset: talking-head (desk) or stage (stage cam / walking subject)
notes.broll: opt-in, less is more: 1-2 cutaways of ~2s; video only; centered; hard cuts, no transitions/SFX; never over the hook or the payoff
notes.captions: Plain spice style — burns over the b-roll.
